customer_name: Shanghai Pudong Development Bank (浦发银行)
business_problem: The bank needed a scalable way to deliver contactless yet personalized financial service to a very large customer base, because human advisers could only serve a few hundred users each and customers increasingly expected always-on support across mobile and branch channels.
solution_summary: Baidu AI Cloud and Shanghai Pudong Development Bank built Xiaopu, a 3D digital employee deployed across the bank's app, online banking, and service terminals as the front end of a broader Future Bank Solution. Xiaopu starts with high-precision 3D capture of a real wealth manager, voice cloning, and text-to-speech so the assistant can speak and interact visually in real time. The service adds facial-expression recognition, acoustic analysis, and semantic understanding to support full-duplex conversation instead of push-to-talk commands. Behind that interface, Baidu's knowledge middle platform organizes knowledge production and use, while user profiles, preferences, and recommendation logic drive one-to-one responses and product suggestions. Real dialogue data feeds continuous tuning, so the assistant improves its understanding, recommendation quality, and conversational style over time. The overall architecture joins multimodal interaction, knowledge management, and recommendation workflows into a single intelligent banking-service channel.

solution_components.name: Xiaopu
solution_components.role: Serves as the digital employee that handles real-time multimodal interactions, product recommendations, and question answering for bank customers.

solution_components.name: Future Bank Solution
solution_components.role: Extends the digital-human service model across cloud seats, displays, holographic devices, and other intelligent banking endpoints.

solution_components.name: Knowledge Middle Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the closed-loop knowledge lifecycle that turns dispersed bank data into searchable knowledge and supports intelligent banking services.

data_flow: Customers start voice interactions in the app, online bank, or service terminals, Xiaopu captures speech and visual cues for semantic analysis, the knowledge middle platform and recommendation logic retrieve or generate answers and product suggestions, and the digital employee returns spoken responses while dialogue data is retained for later tuning.
business_outcome: The bank created a zero-contact banking service channel with more human-like, always-on support, giving each customer access to tailored guidance while laying the foundation for broader intelligent banking services.
architecture_clues: Xiaopu uses 3D full-body capture, voice cloning, TTS, and facial-expression recognition to create a real-time visual assistant.
The service supports full-duplex interaction instead of requiring press-to-talk voice commands.
The knowledge middle platform closes the loop from knowledge production to knowledge application.
evidence_quotes: Customers can talk to Xiaopu one to one in the app and get matched wealth-management products, funds, and asset-allocation plans. (original: 只要说出个人投资目标、投资期限、投资金额以及风险偏好后，小浦即可精准推荐匹配该名用户的理财产品、基金和资产配置方案。)

Xiaopu is the banking industry's first 3D twin digital human and reproduces a real wealth manager's appearance, voice, expressions, and gestures. (original: 作为行业首个 3D 孪生数字人，小浦实际上是真实地还原了一位理财经理的相貌、声音、表情、手势动作。)
The app became the first in the industry to let users interact with a virtual digital human in real time with full-duplex conversation. (original: 这也让浦发银行 App 成为业内第一个实现用户和虚拟数字人实时互动的 App。)

Behind the real-time interaction is intelligent decision-making for one-to-one exclusive service and recommendation based on user profiles and preferences. (original: 在实时交互的背后，是基于用户画像和偏好的一对一专属服务和推荐的智能决策；)

The knowledge middle platform offers a closed loop from knowledge production to knowledge application and gives the bank full-lifecycle knowledge empowerment. (original: 该中台提供从知识生产到知识应用的闭环，具备了知识全生命周期赋能的能力。)
